description.name: Agency Programme
description.tagline: A programme for approved agency clients: tiered benefits by qualifying monthly spend, today a discount applied automatically as a named invoice line.
description.long: Runs a programme for approved agency clients. Approval is set on the client profile; the module measures each agency's qualifying monthly spend and places it in a tier. Today a tier carries a percentage discount, applied automatically as a named invoice line when each invoice is created. Tiers, qualifying products and add-ons are configuration. Includes dry-run mode, an admin overview and a full change log.
features: Approve agency clients on their client profile, with a note and an optional start date
Tiers per currency by qualifying monthly spend, edited in a tier table
Qualifying product groups, products and add-ons chosen by name
Discount added as one named invoice line when WHMCS creates the invoice; service prices are never changed
Separate discount lines for taxed and untaxed items on the same invoice
Dry-run mode, an admin overview, a change log and an admin home widget
Client area panel and page showing tier, spend and savings
